about_the_game:
Anna's most precious snack has been stolen by shadows! In this hand-drawn clicker RPG, play as this young warrior determined to fight her way through the ruins of the Pantheon, an ancient kingdom that has fallen into ruin, and reclaim her treasure from the clutches of the dark beings lurking within the castle.

Map exploration

Explore dungeons marked by encounters blocking your path to your precious basket of madeleines.

Once glorious, the Pantheon was a kingdom built to fight the gods and their followers. Now all that remains are ruins and braziers still filled with magic.

A total of 10 mazes will stand against you, consisting of over 170 rooms in total!

Search and try to find braziers hidden around the map, off the beaten path, to aid you in your ascent to the castle. There are four different types, each increasing a different stat:

Red: Increases left-click damage by one.

Blue: Increases auto-click damage by one.

Green: Increases your health by five. Purple: Increases your special spell damage by one.

Purple: Increases your special spell damage by one.

Will you be able to find all 28 braziers?

Real-time battle

Shadows are formidable enemies that take many forms, from rabid animals to fearless soldiers seeking to hinder your progress. Will you defeat them?

Face waves of enemies trying to reach your character to eliminate them in dynamic battles.

Encounter mechanically and visually diverse enemies. The soldiers will come into contact with you to use their blades while the mages will be at a distance, using their spells to harass you. It's up to you to adapt your battle strategy against the various profiles encountered in the game.

Knockdown powerful bosses with special mechanics that require extra effort to defeat.

A simple gameplay to inflict damage on enemies: just click on them or use one of the hero's four spells spread over four keys.

Choose your way to fight:

  • Left Click: to click quickly and swiftly remove enemies from the screen.

  • Left Click and hold: To deal constant damage without tiring or losing effectiveness.

  • Right Click: a special spell to deal area damage to Anna's melee range. A useful attack when she starts to get crowded.

More than 60 fights await you!
